paths.description: Requested public entry/launcher URL; represents the only discoverable surface. No additional archetype was discoverable because the document contains no links and robots/sitemap/manifest all return 404.
Narrow viewport responsiveness and zoom policy at 360x800.
Raw HTML/non-JavaScript discoverability and resilience view.

findings.summary: The requested casino entry URL returns HTTP 404 and renders an entirely blank black viewport.
findings.evidence: HAR records HTTP 404 for the main document; desktop/mobile screenshots are blank; DOM probe reports zero body children and no text, headings, links, forms, or controls; Lighthouse aborts on the 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve a successful entry document at this URL and render a clear lobby or launch-recovery state when required game parameters/session data are absent.

findings.summary: Failure and missing-session states have no user-visible explanation or recovery action.
findings.evidence: The 404 response still executes the casino shell, but rendered body text is empty and screenshots show no retry, return-to-lobby, sign-in, or help control.
findings.suggestedFix: Render an explicit error/empty state with the reason, a safe lobby link, retry, and support route; expose status changes accessibly.

findings.summary: There is no perceivable content, semantic structure, navigation, or focusable primary action.
findings.evidence: DOM/evaluate evidence reports no H1-H3, anchors, forms, dialogs, body children, or text; the blank screenshot provides no accessible or visual way to orient or act.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide semantic main/heading/navigation landmarks and a clearly labelled primary action or recovery action in the initial HTML.

findings.summary: The viewport explicitly disables pinch zoom.
findings.evidence: meta viewport is `minimum-scale=1, maximum-scale=1, user-scalable=no`, preventing user scaling despite the otherwise overflow-free 360px layout.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale and user-scalable restrictions; retain only width=device-width and an appropriate initial-scale.

findings.summary: The shell hard-codes a black theme and does not declare or respond to the user color-scheme preference.
findings.evidence: DOM CSS sets body and game surfaces to #000; dark-emulation and default screenshots are identical; no color-scheme declaration or prefers-color-scheme rule is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare supported color schemes and use prefers-color-scheme or light-dark() for shell and error-state colors.

findings.summary: Public discovery and sharing signals are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The main document is 404; meta description, canonical, robots metadata, structured data, Open Graph metadata, links, robots.txt, and sitemap.xml are absent/404. Only the title `PP Live Casino` survives.
findings.suggestedFix: Return 200 for the public entry page and add a unique description, canonical, crawlable navigation, valid robots/sitemap policy, and accurate social/structured metadata.

findings.summary: The document lacks baseline browser-enforced security headers.
findings.evidence: Headers primitive confirms HTTPS but no CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, clickjacking protection, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy.
findings.suggestedFix: Set HSTS and nosniff; deploy a restrictive CSP including frame-ancestors; add appropriate Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: The entry experience is not resilient to absent launch context or non-JavaScript access.
findings.evidence: Raw and rendered requests return 404; the HTML contains only an inline-script redirect/launcher and renders no fallback content. Crawler and browser screenshots are both blank.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve meaningful initial HTML and a no-JS/session-missing fallback, then layer launch redirects on as progressive enhancement.

findings.summary: Document and asset delivery is unsound: both the main document and declared favicon return 404.
findings.evidence: HAR summary lists two requests and two HTTP errors, including `/assets/favicon.ico`; Lighthouse cannot complete because the document response is 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Correct origin routing and asset paths, return successful status codes, and add suitable cache headers for versioned assets.

findings.summary: The shell uses physical positioning rather than translation- and direction-safe logical properties.
findings.evidence: HTML has lang=en, but CSS repeatedly uses left/top physical offsets and does not declare direction or logical inset properties.
findings.suggestedFix: Preserve the correct lang attribute and replace direction-sensitive left/right offsets with logical inset properties where they express inline direction.
